sentences.en: • The S.K.I. Bicycle Courier Service first started in the Sudan.
sentences.zh: • S.K.I.自行车库里er服务首次在苏丹启动。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Participants in this enterprise were supplied with bicycles, which they used to deliver parcels and messages, and which they were required to pay for gradually from their wages.
sentences.zh: 企业参与者得到了自行车,他们用自行车运送包裹和信息,他们必须逐步从工资中支付费用。

sentences.en: • Another successful project, The Shoe Shine Collective, was a partnership program with the Y.W.C.A. in the Dominican Republic.
sentences.zh: • 另一个成功的项目,即Shone Shine集体项目,是与多米尼加共和国青年会合作的方案。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In this project, participants were lent money to purchase shoe shine boxes.
sentences.zh: 在这一项目中,向参加者借钱购买擦鞋盒。

sentences.en: • The Youth Skills Enterprise initiative in Zambia is a joint program with the Red Cross Society and the Y.W.C.A. Street youths are supported to start their own small business through business training, life skills training and access to credit.
sentences.zh: • 赞比亚青年技能企业倡议是与红十字会的一项联合方案,Y.W.C.A.街青年通过商业培训、生活技能培训和获得信贷的机会,获得开办小企业的支助。

sentences.zh: 企业家不是人人的事,也不是每个街头儿童的事。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Ideally, potential participants will have been involved in the organisation’s programs for at least six months, and trust and relationship building will have already been established.
sentences.zh: 理想的情况是,潜在的参与者至少参与该组织的方案六个月,建立信任和关系的工作已经建立。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: • The involvement of the participants has been essential to the development of relevant programs.
sentences.zh: • 参与者的参与对于制定相关方案至关重要。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: When children have had a major role in determining procedures, they are more likely to abide by and enforce them.
sentences.zh: 当儿童在确定程序方面发挥重大作用时,他们更有可能遵守和执行这些程序。

sentences.en: Home visits allow staff the opportunity to know where the participants live, and to understand more about each individual’s situation.
sentences.zh: 家庭访问使工作人员有机会了解参加者住在哪里,并了解更多关于每个人情况的信息。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: • Small loans are provided initially for purchasing fixed assets such as bicycles, shoe shine kits and basic building materials for a market stall.
sentences.zh: • 提供小额贷款最初用于购买固定资产,如自行车、鞋贴和市场摊位的基本建筑材料。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: As the entrepreneurs gain experience, the enterprises can be gradually expanded and consideration can be given to increasing loan amounts.
sentences.zh: 随着企业家积累经验,企业可以逐步扩大,可以考虑增加贷款数额。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The loan amounts in S.K.I. programs have generally ranged from US$90-$100.
sentences.zh: 特别信贷方案贷款额一般为90-100美元。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: • All S.K.I. programs have charged interest on the loans, primarily to get the entrepreneurs used to the concept of paying interest on borrowed money.
sentences.zh: • 所有S.K.I.方案都对贷款收取利息,主要是让企业家习惯于用借来的货币支付利息的概念。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Generally the rates have been modest (lower than bank rates)
sentences.zh: 一般来说,利率较低(低于银行利率)

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Conclusion There is a need to recognise the importance of access to credit for impoverished young people seeking to fulfill economic needs.
sentences.zh: 结论需要认识到,贫困青年为设法满足经济需求而获得信贷的重要性。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The provision of small loans to support the entrepreneurial dreams and ambitions of youth can be an effective means to help them change their lives.
sentences.zh: 提供小额贷款支持青年的创业梦想和抱负,可以成为帮助他们改变生活的有效手段。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: However, we believe that credit must be extended in association with other types of support that help participants develop critical kills as well as productive businesses.
sentences.zh: 然而,我们认为,信贷必须与帮助参与者发展关键杀菌和生产企业的其他支助类型相结合提供。
